description: This file defines the LogView class, which is a custom Android TextView for displaying log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and appends the result to the view, supporting chaining with other LogNodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages formatted according to the LogNode interface, supporting chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs log messages including priority, tag, message, and optional exception. Handles UI thread synchronization and forwards to next LogNode if available.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to the StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new log entry in the LogView.
